post.description: Removes an SST that compaction reported corrupted from the manifest, so compaction resumes. Its rows are lost: older versions of its keys show again. `confirm` must repeat the SST id; `force` drops an SST no compaction reported. To lose nothing newer than a checkpoint instead, fork the full range from that checkpoint into a new database.

post.description: Flushes every acknowledged write, then pins the resulting manifest with a checkpoint for lifetimeMs: pass `snapshot` to reads to see exactly that data until `expireAt`. Delete the checkpoint (`checkpointId`) to release it early. Each pinned snapshot is a manifest write; an unpinned snapshot (POST …/snapshots) costs none but is kept only about an hour.

get.description: Returns committed changes after `afterSeq` in sequence order (flushed ones from the changelog, then unflushed ones), never splitting a batch. Continue from `nextAfterSeq`. Requires the database's changelog; fails with ChangelogUnavailable when it is disabled or the changes were dropped by retention.

bearerToken.description: The stage's access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A live stage accepts either of its two rotatable tokens (`vp run @shaledb/infra#tokens`); a preview also accepts the token `preview-cli token <stage>` prints. Local stages are not gated.

servers.description: Local development (`vp run dev`), not gated. A live stage's URL is its API Worker's workers.dev URL.
